threats.title: Spoofing of user's phone
threats.description: The threat that a user's phone could be spoofed and an unauthorized individual could have access to their TikTok app. The main risk here is a possible tampering of the user's app, which could lead to unauthorized information disclosure.
threats.mitigation: Increased authentication mechanisms for user's phones, including multi-factor authentication.

threats.title: Spoofing of user's TikTok account
threats.description: The threat that a user's TikTok account could be spoofed, leading to an unauthorized disclosure of information.
threats.mitigation: One way to limit the risk of this threat is by requiring that stronger authentication mechanisms, such as multi-factor authentication, be used.

threats.title: Spoofing of users' computers
threats.description: The threat that a user's computer may be spoofed, giving an attacker access to the browser the user uses to access TikTok.
threats.mitigation: Ensure to use strong authentication mechanisms, such as multi-factor authentication.

threats.title: Information disclosure via the internet
threats.description: The threat that user information may be disclosed to unauthorized users via the internet (e.g. unsecure protocols leaving packets vulnerable).
threats.mitigation: Developers should only use secure protocols for the app - especially for the browser version of the application.

threats.title: Elevation of privelege
threats.description: A user may be able to use their connection to the internet via their app or browser to attempt to elevate their TikTok privileges.
threats.mitigation: Ensure that the architecture design is sound and that authentication and privilege decisions upon login are secure.

threats.title: User database tampering
threats.description: Tampering of the TikTok user database
threats.mitigation: Solutions involve increased authentication measures to protect privacy and storing a backup of the database external to the primary cloud infrastructure.

threats.title: Denial of service impacting the load balancer
threats.description: The threat that a single load balancer may be overwhelmed with the number of requests received, preventing users from accessing their accounts.
threats.mitigation: A possible mitigation is to include multiple load balancers in the architecture and to have these auto-scale according to demand and quantity of requests received.

threats.title: Elevation of privilege
threats.description: The threat that a developer will attempt to elevate their privileges to access the user database
threats.mitigation: Ensure database authentication mechanisms are string (e.g. multi-factor authentication) and remove all old developer accounts from the system.

threats.title: Spoofing of authorized accounts
threats.description: The threat of database or cloud authorized accounts being spoofed.
threats.mitigation: Ensure to use strong authentication mechanisms, such as multi-factor authentication
